# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Begin filling out your report with the following information:
3. Date of inspection
4. Vehicle Identification Number (VIN)
5. Mileage
6. Brake System Type: (e.g., Disc/Drum, All Disc, ABS)
7. Record all test results, even if they fail.
8. Be very specific about what failed.
9. Note the severity of the failure.
10. Provide recommendations for repair.
11. Include Supporting Documentation
12. Review and sign the Report
